paper_title: Text Generation with Diffusion Language Models A Pre-training Approach   with Continuous Paragraph Denoise
caption: Effect of different diffusion steps on text generation quality, on XSum. The result is the optimal value of 5 Gaussian samples.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the impact of diffusion steps on text generation quality, specifically on the XSum dataset, as indicated by the chart title. The horizontal axis represents the diffusion step, ranging from 0.1 to 2000, with tick labels displayed at intervals of 250, 500, 1000, and 2000. The vertical axis represents the text generation quality, labeled as "ROUGE," with a linear scale from 0 to 100, and tick labels present at intervals of 10. Three distinct datasets, labeled ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L, are represented by bars of different colors: ROUGE-1 is depicted in orange, ROUGE-2 in red, and ROUGE-L in a green-patterned style. For ROUGE-1, bar heights range from approximately 0.1 at a diffusion step of 0.1 to approximately 41.2 at a diffusion step of 2000. ROUGE-2 bars span from a value of roughly 0.1 at 0.1 diffusion step to approximately 41.2 at a diffusion step of 2000. ROUGE-L bar heights range from approximately 0.1 at the lowest diffusion step to roughly 34.4 at the highest. The bars are sorted in ascending order along the diffusion step axis, and no bars are visually emphasized.
